Elnor Emergency Combat Hologram remains a hologram/copied representation; its memory-derived testimony is not treated as Elnor's direct utterance.
Seven's critical injury and Borg restoration are body/state evidence, not an automatic identity split or merge.
Tallinn impersonating Renée is an assumed-identity occurrence, not SAME_AS.
Elnor's post-reset living occurrence remains unresolved relative to the earlier deceased occurrence.
The anomaly-era Jurati-associated Borg Queen remains a distinct local occurrence whose relation to the 2024 composite is unresolved.
Q's dying state and motives remain testimony where sourced from Q/Guinan rather than omniscient fact.
Guinan's account of Rios's later life remains retrospective testimony.
notes: Validation establishes internal referential/methodological integrity only. It does not establish source authority, canonical identity, or accepted coverage.
